game.name: Minecraft Hielke Maps
game.rules:
- No hacks allowed
- The run must be done solo. Other players aren't allowed to assist you in any way.
- No /trigger commands allowed in a run (or in preparation of a run if they exploit the map)
- In multiplayer, don't make use of snakes triggered by other people
- Reuse of previously played map allowed. For example having the doors/trapdoors be already open when doing a run. 
- You must show the final in-game timer at the end of the run.
- The run must be done in one sitting. You must try to avoid pausing the game as much as possible, as pausing too much will result in your run being rejected. The total amount spent paused (by pressing escape or standing afk in pyramid for instance) shouldn't exceed 1 minute.
- Relogging is not allowed
- If your actual run is only a portion of the video you submit, please include the start time in the description of the submission.
- Using pauses to gain extra height on slime glitches is not allowed

- Abusing lag is not allowed. 
This includes, but is not limited to : 
1) More than 1.5625 blocks high damage boosts.
2) Abusing levitation combined with lag to land on normally inaccessible spots.
3) Abnormally high bounces from slime glitches or slime glitches setups made easier due to lag. You can find a list of the most ambiguous slime glitches here : https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLFZ1K7ZmCOPvQju0AMeem1QAPzE0IlcZT 
Note that accidentally getting a higher bounce from a slime glitch but not taking advantage of it will not result in a rejection of your run. If you are unsure whether a certain slime glitch shortcut can only be done with lag or not, feel free to ask in the discord.
We strongly advise to use singleplayer for your runs. Lag appears way more often when playing on a multiplayer server. If you have any questions regarding any of the rules, feel free to post a thread on the forums or send a message in the discord. 
You can quickly check if your game is lagging by holding space while taking fall damage. If you instantly jump after taking fall damage, your game is not lagging. However, if as soon as you are landing on the ground, the game prevents you from immediately jumping again, your game is lagging. In singleplayer, pausing / unpausing the game should remove the lag (Open to LAN must not be enabled). In multiplayer however, you can't control the lag.

newsList.title: Version category split
newsList.body:
In 1.21.2 Mojang **fixed the sneak slime glitch**, which is the most used glitch used in speedruns, because of that, from now on, **all the old runs are moved into 1.20~1.21.1 category, and the default category is now 1.21.2+**.

You can still submit Pre-1.21.2 runs if you want, just don't forget to

categories.name: Any%

Abuse of game mechanics usually goes to Major Glitches%

Abuse of map mechanics allowed

categories.name: Any% Glitchless
categories.rules:
Are not allowed :
- Damage boosts
- Slime glitches
- Riptide boosts
- Spawn protection skips
- Groll (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UBpUdFRLi8)
- In Parkour Pyramid, jumping on the edge of quartz blocks which are supposed to kill you (like in the level 62 skip)

Are allowed :
- Inventory Jam
- Abusing elytra mechanics to jump higher
- In Parkour Pyramid, dying on the edge of a level to spawn at the beginning of the next one (like the level 15 to 16 skip)

categories.name: Major Glitches%
categories.rules:
Can use any glitches that don't involve:

Pausing the game

Relogging
